headline: Good news for vehicle owners! Diesel gets a cut: current petrol, diesel and LPG prices for 5 August 2026
summary: Diesel prices in Türkiye fell by an average of 1 lira per litre, now below 83 lira, following the drop in oil prices linked to US-Iran tension. The cut was reflected at pumps from the same day.
why: Fuel prices in Türkiye are set in line with international crude and refined product prices, affecting transport costs and inflation.
